(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles having a particle size of approximately 30-200 μm; a thermally conductive binder that is selected from the group consisting of solder paste and adhesive; and a solvent that is selected from the group consisting of ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to a surface of an electronic component that is selected from the group consisting of a silicon chip and a microelectronic component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during the application to the surface of the electronic component.
